verdict.rationale: Solid's components can run without a browser through server-side rendering, serverless support, and isomorphic rendering, plus custom renderers that let Solid run anywhere. That implies it can be driven non-interactively in scripts or server pipelines. Its Vite integration and npx-based scaffolding fit standard command-line toolchains. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly covers running Solid in CI, headless testing, or automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI/headless usage, headless test-runner guidance, automation-oriented examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
